objects_and_maps: r5:G_Q→GL2(C_5 finite); identify a cuspidal eigenform up to character twist, then its weight-two primitive newform f.
hypotheses_and_discharge: Consumes continuity, absolute irreducibility, oddness, finite ramification, distinct weights, and potential semistability established upstream. Also consumes the standard modular Galois representation with its de Rham property and weight normalization in Pan's modular conclusion.
conventions: Tate weights {0,-1}, modular weights {0,1-k}; dual cohomological convention reverses both. One-dimensional de Rham twist is finite-order times an integral cyclotomic power.
translation_justification: Pan v2 Theorem 1.0.4 has no residual-image exception at p=5. The Hom character is de Rham; Conrad local algebraicity over Q5 removes an integral cyclotomic power, and global class field theory gives a finite character. Weights force k=2 and power zero. Twist the form and take its primitive newform. Li supplies Fricke stability of its full coefficient-conjugate span. Shimura constructs the quotient and product Euler factors. Compare the entire Tate module with the direct sum of the conjugate modular representations by Chebotarev and semisimple trace identification, then select the chosen summand. Duality gives the H1 constituent and preserves conductor.

## A063: actual Hom and complement over L'

Consumer: lines 824-831. Exact sources: Faltings 1983, section 5, Corollary 1, printed p. 361, with the 1984 erratum discussed above; Milne AV v2.00, Part I Proposition 10.1 and its proof, printed p. 42. The latter proof constructs the complement of a specified abelian subvariety using the connected kernel of its dual inclusion composed with a polarization. It works over the ground field. The note about imperfect fields is irrelevant over L'.

A011 supplies the modular realization over a common finite coefficient field; restricting to G_L' and using the two-copy identification gives the stated common constituent of V_l(A) and V_l(J). Faltings semisimplicity means common constituent here supplies a nonzero equivariant map A-to-J on Tate spaces, after coefficient extension. Invariants in finite-dimensional Hom commute with extension: a finite intersection of kernels defines the invariant space, even when the group is infinite. Therefore there was a nonzero rational l-adic invariant before extending coefficients. Faltings' Hom isomorphism then implies Hom_L'(A,J) is nonzero. It is enough that this group tensored with Q_l is nonzero; one need not claim the specific invariant matrix is an actual integral morphism.

The non-CM quaternion division endomorphism algebra makes A absolutely simple, as in the preceding branch. A nonzero morphism A -> J has finite kernel and image B0 of dimension two. Milne's complement Z to B0 in J is defined over L', and A times Z -> J is an L'-isogeny. Its dimension gives g>=2. This is the direction initially constructed; A015 supplies the opposite direction with its bound.

Accept conditional on A008/A011 and the established non-CM quaternion endomorphism algebra. No descent of Z beyond L' or integral equality of Tate lattices is claimed.

title: Compatible traces and semisimple identification
source_locator: Part I Theorem 12.1(a), p. 55; Theorem 10.15, p. 49; Proposition 10.20, p. 50; Lemma 14.5, p. 63; Part IV Theorem 3.5, pp. 141-142 and Lemma 3.9, p. 143.; Version 4.03, August 6, 2020, Chapter VIII Theorem 7.4.
objects_and_maps: Reduction of mu_sigma∘relative Frob_p is an actual endomorphism; traces of r3,r5 compared through one number field C.
hypotheses_and_discharge: Consumes the already integral isogenies mu_sigma, the scalar splitting cochain, common coefficient embeddings, good reduction, and the modular realization from A011. Semisimplicity and the Chebotarev result remain upstream premises.
conventions: Do not take trace of an undefined semilinear map or compare only powers of Frobenius. Preserve arithmetic Frobenius and duality.
translation_justification: Choose sigma above x->x^p in the Qp decomposition group, not residue-field Frobenius x->x^Norm(v). The composite of relative p-Frobenius and reduced mu_sigma is an actual endomorphism. Its characteristic polynomial is independent of ell by Milne I.10.20. The scalar beta^-1 and half-trace recover the rank-two trace across coefficient embeddings. Chebotarev gives equality of continuous class traces; apply Milne IV.3.9 to the finite coefficient algebra spanned by the joint image in End(V plus W). This proves isomorphism of semisimple representations, with no integral lattice assertion.
